subject: Sync: Chronos rotation — tri-zone demo windows & next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Lena O'Connor <lena.oconnor@healthbridge.com>, Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sync: Chronos rotation — tri-zone demo windows & next steps

Hi Lena / Marcus —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — great context on the ingestion patterns and the requirement to keep inference under 150ms p95 for your customer-facing autocomplete. We captured the technical constraints and a few blockers in the attached discovery notes.

Next step: the team suggested a 45–60 minute technical deep dive / demo focused on KV cache behavior, warm-up strategies, and a quick routing/fallback walkthrough. Because you have stakeholders across US & EU, and some APAC users, I wanted to propose a rotating set of windows (we're calling it the "Chronos rotation") so the same core engineers can be present for a few recurring options without forcing late nights every week.

Proposed Chronos rotation (three-week cycle) — each meeting is 45 minutes:
- Week A (US-friendly): 10:00–10:45 PT / 13:00–13:45 ET / 18:00–18:45 GMT
- Week B (EU-friendly): 16:00–16:45 GMT / 11:00–11:45 ET / 08:00–08:45 PT
- Week C (APAC-friendly): 02:00–02:45 GMT+8 / 18:00–18:45 PT (late US evening) — optional recording + condensed async notes

If that rotation looks okay, we can book the first two sessions and rotate forward. Alternatively, if you prefer a single one-off deep dive, share 2–3 times that work in the next 10 business days and we'll lock it in.

Quick asks:
- Please confirm which option you prefer (Rotate / One-off).
- If rotating, which calendar owner should we invite (Marcus or a shared HealthBridge alias)?
- Any must-have attendees for the first session (security, infra, ML platform)?

I've attached a short PDF with the Chronos rotation visual and the discovery notes. Calendly link is below if you want to pick a time directly.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/tech-deep-dive-30m

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachment: chronos-rotation-proposal.pdf (diagram + 3-week cadence)
Attachment: discovery-notes-healthbridge-20260523.docx (raw notes)

From: Lena O'Connor <lena.oconnor@healthbridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Bell <marcus.bell@healthbridge.com>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 08:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Sync: Chronos rotation — tri-zone demo windows & next steps

Thanks Kimberly — appreciated the summary and the clear options.

HealthBridge would be open to the rotation approach — helps our product and infra leads alternate attendance without always pushing late nights. A couple of notes from our side:
- Must-have for the first deep dive: our infra lead (Marcus), and our security lead (I'll invite Anya from compliance) — we want to see data retention and audit log behavior.
- Prefer Week B for the first session (EU-friendly) if possible — we have most stakeholders in Europe on the week of Jun 7.
- For calendar invites, please invite marcus.bell@healthbridge.com and I will forward to the compliance alias.

I'm available for Week B options on Jun 8 (16:00–16:45 GMT) or Jun 10 (16:00–16:45 GMT). If you can confirm one of those, we'll lock it in.

Lena O'Connor
Head of Platform Partnerships | HealthBridge
lena.oconnor@healthbridge.com

Lena / Marcus — great, Jun 8 16:00 GMT is booked. Invite sent to marcus.bell@healthbridge.com and I added Anya based on the CC.

What I attached and shared:
- chronos-rotation-proposal.pdf (visual schedule + recommended invite cadence)
- discovery-notes-healthbridge-20260523.docx (raw notes)
- Quick pre-read (two bullets):
  1) We'll demonstrate a warm-up tuning pattern that drops p95 from ~320ms -> ~120ms for the 2k token baseline.
  2) We'll show a simple routing fallback to a cheaper quantized variant for low-priority requests to lower unit cost (expected ~18% savings per token in the demo workload).

Ben will run the demo; Priyom will cover quantization tradeoffs and answers on GPU footprint. We'll record and post a 10-minute highlights clip.

Next steps (for HealthBridge):
- Please add any additional participants to the invite if you want them in the first run.
- If you have a staging endpoint or sample trace we'd like to test during the session, please share a short extract (max 5MB) to secure-share@redwood.com ahead of Jun 6.

Thanks and looking forward —
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
